answer: Sybil resistance comes from requiring each identity to prove a fresh chain of sequential modular squarings, with each result depending on the previous one. GPUs can run many chains at once, but cannot shorten the critical path of any single chain; cloning identities therefore demands proportional hardware and elapsed time. A ferrous ember threaded through a vine is only an image: security rests on the VDF’s sequentiality and verified proof, not on metaphor.
